candidates.rule: Use the authoritative C3, C2 and unchanged Short Pullback contracts without an additional permission or exit rule.

candidates.primary_mechanism: Avoid C2 winner damage in cross-strategy overlap states
candidates.rule: Apply the frozen F05 C2 60-second exit only when B02 overlap_count at F05 Entry is zero; otherwise retain the original F05 exit.
candidates.information_time: B02 owned-position state at F05 Entry plus the frozen C2 state at Entry+60 seconds

candidates.primary_mechanism: Localize C3 to early breakout acceptance failure
candidates.rule: Arm and execute C3 only if its first profit-to-nonprofit giveback boundary occurs no later than the 16th completed M15 boundary after Entry; otherwise retain the original 48-bar B02 exit.
candidates.information_time: Completed M15 executable boundary state only
candidates.threshold_rationale: One third of the original 48-bar B02 lifecycle; separates immediate/slow acceptance failure from late lifecycle without a threshold grid.

candidates.primary_mechanism: Prevent SP39 entry only in an active losing same-direction parent cluster
candidates.rule: Keep the unchanged SP39 signal and 16-bar lifecycle, but veto Entry only when at least two owned B02/F05 positions with the same Short direction are already open and their aggregate executable floating P/L is negative at the SP39 Entry tick.
candidates.information_time: Owned parent positions and executable floating P/L at the SP39 Entry tick
candidates.not_reused: HYP-038 C5_COEXPOSURE_SKIP; this rule requires both count>=2 and negative floating P/L and does not veto generic coexposure.

candidates.parent_architecture: B02_C3 + F05_C2; SP39 remains unchanged and outside the Round A cap
candidates.primary_mechanism: Limit repeated realized loss persistence after C2/C3
candidates.rule: Process matured closes before entries. Reset at each UTC session boundary or realized winner. After two consecutive realized losses in the active UTC session, block subsequent B02/F05 entries until the next session boundary.
candidates.information_time: Realized owned-position closes and UTC session state before each Entry
candidates.new_candidate_scope: Recomputed on the P3 parent architecture; not a retrospective adoption of the old baseline SESSION_LOSS_CAP_2 result.
